text.en:
3rd. AUGUST, 2005 No. S 55

PAWNBROKERS ORDER, 2002 (S 60/02} NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1{1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1). the Minister of Finance/ with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. August, 2005 as the date on which the Pawnbrokers Order 2002 shall commence. 1 Dated this 27th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1426 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. day of August, 2005.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI ALI BIN APONG Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
